$comment: OWNERSHIP OF NAMES, RECORDED 2026-10-08. This file is the contract for the ARTIFACT-preflight REPORT emitted by src/design_lab/assurance/production_preflight.py (schemaVersion design-lab/artifact-preflight/v1), which is what GET /api/projects/<id>/bundles/<id>/preflight returns and what apps/workbench shell.ts `artifactPreflightPanel` renders. Its top-level outcome field is `verdict` (PASS|WARN|BLOCKED|INCOMPLETE) and it has NO `status` field anywhere. It is deliberately NOT design-lab/schemas/preflight.schema.json: that file declares const schemaVersion design-lab/preflight/v2 and requires preflight_id + required_checks, which is the shape of the PROFILE documents under design-lab/production/profiles/ (validated against it by design-lab/scripts/verify_production_preflight.py) plus an optional nested `result` report consumed by assurance/handoff_readiness.py. The two contracts share no field set and must not be conflated. `verdict` is not renamed to `status` because the Workbench column reads `verdict` from the HTTP response today (design-lab/tests/test_artifact_preflight_ui_contract.py pins the payload); renaming would break a live consumer for a drift that does not exist. The emitter and this schema are held against each other in BOTH directions by design-lab/scripts/verify_artifact_preflight_contract.py.
title: Artifact Preflight Report V1 (measured production checks on a delivery artifact)
description: 产物预检报告：对交付归档/产物实测后的逐条结论。每条 finding 必带判据 criterion；存在 NOT_MEASURED 时顶层 verdict 必须停在 INCOMPLETE，不得为 PASS。

profile.description: 本次运行使用的 profile；必须与 design-lab/production/profiles/preflight-<profile>.json 一一对应。

profileSchema.description: 所用 profile 自己声明的 schemaVersion（design-lab/preflight/v2），不是本报告的类型。

verdict.description: 顶层结论。与 production_preflight.VERDICTS 同集合；由检查项聚合而来，不是人工填写。

dpi.description: 容器自报的 (x, y) DPI；未记录时为 null，本构建不猜。

findings.description: profile 声明的每条检查都必须出现在这里；artifact-present / archive-digest 是本构建自带的存在性与摘要条目。

criterion.description: 判定所依据的标准及其来源；没有判据的结论不允许进入本报告。

measured.description: 实际读到的数值；NOT_MEASURED 时必须为空对象，不得发布没读过的数字。

archive.description: 仅 preflight_archive / preflight_bundle 入口产出：被预检的交付归档本身。
